explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 819 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA posted the bacteriostatic water shortage on 2021-12-03 and it has remained on the list for 59 months as of 2026-10-21.
Our product label names Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) as a registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1106244 at that plant ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25 — 819 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25, 618 days before the posting.
The label also names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) as a registered plant, which received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 590 days before the posting.
Corvale East holds 40 units at 3.6 per day (11 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 83 units at 4.2 per day (20 days on hand).
The rule‑ranked alternate manufacturer is Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Q-0b8264.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%bacteriostatic%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%bacteriostatic%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-fbc5ef.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('87d6e9dc-fe3b-4593-ac9a-d7493d1959c7') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-24061a.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%bacteriostatic%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-9d52c5.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%bacteriostatic%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-3967de.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%bacteriostatic%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-b77a28.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '1925262', '3008316085') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-455175.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '1925262', '3008316085') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-7501b2.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '1925262', '3008316085') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hospira', 'pfizer india')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-7985bc.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hospira', 'pfizer india') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%bacteriostatic%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-dadc9a.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('639034', '732886', '740633', '976095', '1064827', '1106244') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-74953b.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409397703')
